[[ABA League]] | team = Mega Vizura | team_link = KK Mega Vizura | number = 9 | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1994|1|13}} | birth_place = [[Kraljevo]], [[Republic of Serbia (1990–2006)|Serbia]], [[Federal Republic of Yugoslavia|FR Yugoslavia]] | nationality = Serbian | draft = | draft_year = | draft_team = | career_start = 2010 | career_end = | years1 = 2010–present | team1 = [[KK Mega Vizura|Mega Vizura]] | awards = | medal_templates = {{MedalSport | Men's [[basketball]]}} {{MedalCountry|{{SRB}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Under-19 World Championship|FIBA World U19 Championship]]}} {{MedalSilver| [[2013 FIBA Under-19 World Championship|2013 Czech Republic]] | [[Serbia national basketball team|National team]]}} }} '''Vasilije Micić''' (born January 13, 1994) is a Serbian professional [[basketball]] player. He is a 1.95 m (6 ft 5 in) [[point guard]] who currently plays for [[KK Mega Vizura|Mega Vizura]] of the [[Basketball League of Serbia|Serbian League]]. He also represents the [[Serbia national basketball team|Serbian national basketball team]] internationally. ==Professional career== He began to play basketball with juniors of [[OKK Beograd]]. He also played with juniors of [[KK Crvena zvezda|Red Star Belgrade]] and [[KK FMP|FMP Železnik]].{{cite web|title=Vasilije Micić|url=http://www.beobasket.net/page/club/sr/players.html?view=player&id=929|publisher=Bebasket.net|accessdate=8 July 2013}} In 2010 he came to [[KK Mega Vizura|Mega Vizura]]. At the age of 16 he made his debut in [[Basketball League of Serbia|Serbian League]], and played 35 games. In his second senior season he got injured and played only 8 games.{{cite news | url=http://www.kosarka24.com/vesti/1a-liga-srbije/vesti/6774 | title=Micić teže povređen | language=Serbian | publisher=kosarka24.com | date=24 November 2011 | accessdate=8 July 2013}} In season 2012-13 with [[Boban Marjanović]] he became a leader of the team which came to the [[ABA League|Adriatic League]] for the first time in the team history. ==Serbian national team== With [[Serbia men's national under-18 and under-19 basketball team|Serbia under-18 team]] at [[2011 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]] he won silver medal. With Serbia under-19 team at [[2013 FIBA Under-19 World Championship]] he also won silver medal. He was in All-Tournament Team.{{cite news | url=http://www.mvp.rs/vesti/reprezentacije/item/4566-u19-micic-najbolji-plejmejker-prvenstva | title=U19: Micić najbolji plejmejker Prvenstva |
